profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Automation @ SpaceX

positions.title: High-Performance Computing (HPC) Graduate Intern
positions.description:
During my second year at USC, I worked at the Center for High-Performance Computing as a graduate intern. Among my projects, I developed a comprehensive user guide for scientific parallel computing using R within the HPC Linux cluster.

My main development project was a modular web application built with PHP, MySQL, and responsive web design frameworks with the ultimate goal of enabling instructors to easily build and deploy user assessments as needed.

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer
positions.description:
After the first year of my Computer Science Masters at the University of Southern California, I returned to Lockheed Martin Aeronautics for the summer and deployed into the Software Quality Engineering team. As a Software Quality Engineer, I was responsible for conducting process and product software development evaluations, providing independent visibility into the software development process as defined by applicable Software Quality and Development program Plans. 

Some of my activities included leading the team as an Agile Scrum Master, and evaluating Avionics Software Testing in the simulation laboratories.

positions.title: F-16 Quality Engineer
positions.description: For my last OLDP rotation, and prior to starting graduate school, I worked as an F-16 Quality Engineer on the manufacturing floor. My duties ranged from leading the deployment of inspection technologies for manufacturing inspections, to the development of automated data analytics solutions for reportable quality metrics.

positions.title: F-35 Affordability Project Engineer
positions.description: For my first Aeronautics experience, I worked in the F-35 Affordability department as a Project Engineer, where I managed budget, schedule, technical requirements, and the approval cycle for an array F-35 affordability projects, in an overall effort to drive down the flyaway cost of the fifth-generation fighter jet.

positions.title: Technical Assistant to the Director of Supply Chain Management & Strategy
positions.description: For my second OLDP rotation, I had the privilege of working as direct technical support for the Director of Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Strategy for Space Systems. During the 6-month stint, I became a leading contributor in the development of tools and systems for the maximization of business results.

positions.title: Operations Engineer - Electronics Manufacturing (OLDP)
positions.description:
After undergraduate graduation, I was accepted into Lockheed Martin's Operations Leadership Development Program, a cross-functional rotational experience allowing me to delve into the realms of space exploration and aeronautics. 

For my first rotation, I was responsible for managing electronics production schedules for multiple satellite programs. I also contributed to manufacturing cycle time reduction by developing VBA tools that used material requirements data from SAP networks to visually pinpoint production orders on the shop floor in real-time.

positions.title: Photolithography Process Engineering Co-op
positions.description: At Intel, I worked in a class 10 clean room and became ingrained within the extraordinarily intricate world of photolithography. In managing five layers of microprocessor technology, it was my duty to perform statistical process control analysis of critical metrics to ensure the stability of the manufacturing process through the identification of sources of variation. I was also exposed to development process of engineering work instructions and design of experiments in a variety of projects.

positions.title: Circuit Card Assembly Manufacturing Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
At Raytheon, I was embedded within a state of the art circuit card assembly manufacturing facility, where I was directly exposed to electrical component research activities, with a focus on component fault data to identify patterns and trends for design engineers. 

Among other things, I developed and implemented a data analytics/management database. The tool used and manipulated shop floor data to give engineers an easy-to-use, visually impacting tool to manage and control manufacturing operations for plant-wide product quality and compliance (e.g. part tracking, non-conformance data, manufacturing work-in-progress, etc.).

positions.title: Manufacturing Operations Co-op
positions.description: During my first work experience I was directly exposed to the manufacturing operations of commercial and military aircraft engines. My primary responsibility at GE was to manage, analyze, and visualize an array of business critical metrics utilized on a daily basis by management to make operational decisions.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Industrial Engineering, Double minor in Mechanical Engineering & Business Administration

honors.title: Special Recognition & SPOT Award
honors.description: Received a compensated recognition award for my contributions to the F-16 Software Quality Engineering team during the summer.
honors.issuer: Issued by Lockheed Martin Aeronautics · Aug 2017
